versions.subject: feat: add new rules related to linux reverse shells (#4166)
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|contains: '/php'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -r '
        - 'fsockopen'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'ash'
        - 'bash'
        - 'bsh'
        - 'csh'
        - 'ksh'
        - 'pdksh'
        - 'sh'
        - 'tcsh'
        - 'zsh'
condition: selection
